title: Pure monitoring core: snapshot types, bucketing, red evaluation
done_when: npm run test:ai-monitoring passes; suite covers: parseMonitoringSnapshot rejects malformed shapes (returns null, never a partial); assembleParseCounts produces exactly 7 Melbourne-day buckets oldest-first with zero days present and bucket sums equal to the two totals; evaluateRed returns false when money unavailable, true below the $ floor, true above the % ceiling, and one boolean when both trip; capOutstanding = cap - billedSpend. package.json gains test:ai-monitoring and the file is appended to the test:pure list (line 17) so npm test runs it. Design 02-design.md sections 3.1-3.3.

title: IO shell: money fetch, count query, snapshot write/read, notification sources

title: Route GET /api/ops/monitoring, ops trigger tag, cron append
done_when: api-edge subtests pass against the booted worker: anon request to /api/ops/monitoring gets 401 with no balance/spend/cap/count values in the body; customer session gets 403 likewise; manufacturer-partner session gets 403 likewise (guard is isStaffUser at ops.ts:110, NOT the bare resolveStaff /summary uses); staff 200 body is {snapshot,notificationCount} and contains no token, no account id, no gateway credentials; before first cron write snapshot is null and notificationCount 0. ops.ts:2074 call passes 'ops' to retryCurrentAiExtraction. worker/index.ts scheduled() (line 340) appends writeMonitoringSnapshot(env).catch(...) matching siblings at 344-353; crons list in wrangler.jsonc unchanged.

title: Attention page monitoring cards + 7-day CSS-bar chart
done_when: Monitoring section renders BELOW the existing attention groups: credit-balance card ($12.34 style), cap-outstanding card showing headroom and the cap it was measured against, success and error count cards, and a 7-column CSS-bar chart (success+error per day, zero days as zero columns, all-zero window renders an explicit empty state). Money cards render an 'unavailable' state (not zero, not red) when money.available is false while count cards and chart still show D1 numbers. Every card states 'as at HH:MM' from takenAt (Melbourne time). snapshot null renders a 'no snapshot yet' state. No Cloudflare call from the page: useMonitoring fetches /api/ops/monitoring only (copy useSummary.ts mechanics). npm run typecheck:gate green; matches approved mock docs/mocks/ai-parse-monitoring.html.

title: Notification bubble: shared count hook, desk bell badge, phone tab badge
done_when: useNotificationCount reads .notificationCount from /api/ops/monitoring with a module-level cache (~60s TTL, shared inflight promise) so bell and tab share one fetch.
